svg.title: super-seo: rank in Google, get cited by AI
svg.desc: A three-panel comic. Panel 1: a sad SaaS website sits at #47 on page 5 of Google while AI crawler bots bounce off a 403 wall. Panel 2: the super-seo robot hero flies in and fixes things with SSR, schema, sitemap and unblocking bots, as code patches appear. Panel 3: the happy website rises to #1 and ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude and Copilot cite it.

g.text: RANK IN GOOGLE. GET CITED BY AI.

svg.text: A CLAUDE CODE SKILL · CODE-FIRST SEO + GEO FOR SAAS
